g.text: Everything labs 2.1 – 2.3 leave behind, and the order it appears in
The network you end up with
Auth · World · Database · AppSvc Bastion · Gateway Auth · World · Database · AppSvc
three VNets, ten subnets, two peerings — and each peering is two objects
Bastion in the hub, six NSGs, three ASGs — no workload VM gets a public IP
public and private DNS zones, two load balancers, health probes on TCP 8085
the address plan every later module depends on
The three /16 ranges must not overlap — peering creation fails if they do.
